On the right wall, a floating low-profile white lacquer media console spans most of the wall width, with a large flat screen TV mounted above, and a small abstract artwork in sandy tones leaning against the wall. A small reed diffuser in a dark glass bottle and small ceramic vessels dot the console. A large fiddle-leaf tropical plant in a pot occupies the left corner. On the left, a dining table edge with textured brown upholstered dining chairs is partially visible. The floor is large-format light grey concrete-look porcelain tile. The palette is warm off-white, cream, putty grey, and deep green with matte black accents. Camera is standing height, wide lens, centered view looking toward the glass wall, level pitch.
